what_this_is: Settings for harness/ask-trillion-first.mjs. Which harness consults Trillion, by which road and with which read tools is DATA on that harness's row in src/harnesses.json (consults_trillion: road, read_tools, claims_need_read). Nothing here names a harness.
refusal: Ask Trillion before you finish. Nothing in this turn has read from Trillion yet, and the person has told you to consult it every time. Call one read tool now ({tools}), use what it returns, then answer.{claims} This turn is only refused once.
claims_sentence: That includes before you say something is missing, not connected or not possible: Trillion holds the person's connected accounts, messages, files and decisions, so look there first and say what it answered.
